en-US.description: Zero-ping DPI shield, 8-stream turbo downloads, and broadband telemetry for Windows.
en-US.longDescription: Savy monitors broadband connection health, protects monthly data quota from heavy background downloads, and accelerates web transfers with multithreaded downloads. Includes an optional kernel-level packet desynchronization engine to unblock Discord voice and Roblox with zero added latency.
